name: Bosnia and Herzegovina
description: Bosnia and Herzegovina from its medieval kingdom to Ottoman and Habsburg rule, Sarajevo 1914, Yugoslavia, the war of the 1990s and today.

checkpoints.name: The medieval kingdom
checkpoints.note: Bosnian bans and then kings ruled; Tvrtko was crowned in 1377.

checkpoints.name: Ottoman Bosnia
checkpoints.note: The Ottomans took Bosnia in 1463. Sarajevo and Mostar grew as Ottoman towns, and many Bosnians became Muslim.

checkpoints.name: Habsburgs and Yugoslavia
checkpoints.note: Austria-Hungary took Bosnia in 1878, and the shots in Sarajevo in 1914 started the First World War. Bosnia then became part of Yugoslavia.

checkpoints.name: War and peace
checkpoints.note: Bosnia declared independence in 1992. Three and a half years of war followed, and the Dayton Agreement of 1995 made the state of today.
